entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie, agent ID 402. How can I help you today?
Hi, Charlie. I... I need to make a return. It's for the VeloBand Pulse I ordered.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and order number, please?
Yes, it's Maria Valenti, order number VF77819.

Thank you, Maria. I have your account pulled up. I'm sorry to hear you want to return the VeloBand. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, it's not broken or anything. It's just... I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, but things are a bit tight right now. I thought I could swing it, but I really needed this money back. It's causing me a lot of stress.

I understand completely. Looking at the tracking, I see the VeloBand was delivered on January 9th, which was 12 days ago. Unfortunately, for the VeloBand Pulse, we have a very strict 10-day return policy due to the way the device activates and for hygiene reasons.
Oh no. But I tried! I promise I tried to return it on Sunday, the 18th. That was day nine. I went on your website, but it just wouldn't work. I felt so helpless.
You tried to process the return on our website this past Sunday? Can you tell me what happened?

Yes. There was some kind of big **website error**. I filled out the whole form, but the final page just kept loading and loading. I thought the whole **system was down**. I **couldn't print** the label or even get a confirmation. I was so worried this would happen, I even took a **screenshot** of the error page on my phone.

Thank you for that detail, Maria. Let me just check our internal system logs for that day... Yes. I see it right here. We had a documented system outage on the 18th that impacted the returns portal. I am so sorry you ran into that; that is completely our fault.
Oh, thank goodness. I was so worried I was just stuck with it. I was really counting on that refund.

Not at all. Since this was a business fault, I am absolutely overriding the policy and approving this return for a full refund. I'm emailing you a prepaid shipping label as we speak. On top of that, I see you're one of our VIP members. For the trouble our website caused, I'm also adding a $50 store credit to your account.
Wow, Charlie. Really? A full refund and a credit? That... that is such a relief. You've completely turned my day around. Thank you so much for understanding.
It's my pleasure, Maria. We appreciate your loyalty to VeloFit, and the last thing we want is for our technical issues to cause you any stress. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again, so much.
You're very welcome. Just pack the item up, attach the label I sent, and drop it off. We'll process your refund as soon as it's received. Have a wonderful day!
